paragraphs.source_en: Lady Yodo's envoys had heard none of the ronin's discussions. Like Lady Yodo herself, they therefore set out with innocent expectations, enjoying their journey in the spring sunshine. The elderly ladies had been treated graciously by Ieyasu on their previous mission, and this time they were accompanied by Lady Yodo's own younger sister, Jōkō-in, who had helped bring about the peace. They were therefore convinced that Ieyasu would receive them even more kindly.

paragraphs.source_en: To Ieyasu, this request was an irritating little stratagem.
